name: Briefs and planning
summary: Looking back and ahead: briefs and digests, memory analytics, proactive triggers, commitments, intentions and knowledge gaps.

features.name: Briefs and digests
features.summary: Morning, daily, weekly and monthly briefs, a today dashboard, an operator summary and a logging discipline report.
capabilities: Serves seven brief views through `brain_brief`, one an operator view with the trust verdict and top actions
Composes the morning brief: top 10 rules, open questions, 7 days of notes, up to 5 triggers, open decisions
Folds `Brain/log` events into counters and transitions for daily, weekly and monthly briefs
Digest covers 24 h (or `--window Nd`): new, confirmed, retired preferences, confidence shifts, contradictions
With `report_snapshots_enabled`, digest, daily and weekly snapshot JSON to `Brain/reports/` and diff each run
Today lists due and overdue obligations, open pledges, open loops, 7 days of activity and totals
`discipline report` sets ok, info or alert from yesterday's per-agent signals versus git and file activity
Writes `Brain/profile.md`, a digest of counts, top preferences and activity for the shell (`brain profile`)
limits: Deterministic and model-free; writes only trigger delivery marks, opt-in snapshots and `Brain/profile.md`
`discipline report` is off unless `discipline_report.enabled` is set in `_brain.yaml`

features.name: Memory analytics
features.summary: Event timelines, how a belief evolved, attention recipes over open loops, and concept clusters.
capabilities: `brain timeline` lists `Brain/log` events filtered by preference id, topic, kind, date range and limit
`brain evolution` traces a preference or topic: dream-run status transitions, evidence counts, retirements
`attention-flows` evaluates recipe pages: open proposals, high recurrence, active procedures, standing queries
Seeds a default `open-loops.md` recipe in `Brain/attention-flows/` on first use
`brain synthesise <id>` builds a concept cluster: the target, its depth-1 linkers, optional unlinked mentions
`brain_analytics view=dedup` reports the exact-hash ingest dedup trend per capture surface
Every lens is a deterministic fold over stored records; no model is called
limits: The dedup trend counts exact-hash matches only, not near-duplicates

features.name: Proactive triggers and foresight
features.summary: A deduplicated queue of grounded prompts to act, snooze or dismiss, and a projection of what comes due.
capabilities: `trigger scan` makes triggers from contradictions, stale claims, retention actions and cross-agent collisions
Keeps each trigger as a Markdown file in `Brain/triggers/`; a cooldown key dedupes repeats across all statuses
Defers a snoozed trigger for 3 days or until its grounding moves
Brings a dismissed trigger back only when its grounding moves
Expires open triggers after 14 days and keeps at most 10 per kind
An unreadable trigger file is named in every read instead of hiding the rest of the queue
`brain foresight` projects routines due in 14 days by cadence, plus open commitments and questions of 30 days
Saves the projection as a dated note under `Brain/foresight/` with `foresight --write`
limits: No scheduled scan: triggers appear when a scan runs or another verb enqueues its findings
Foresight is a deterministic projection, not a planner; it creates no tasks

features.name: Obligations, pledges and agenda
features.summary: Recurring obligations with next-due dates, quoted pledges with due dates, agendas from events, counterparty briefs.
capabilities: `brain obligation add|done|list|show|remove` keeps recurring obligations as pages in `Brain/obligations/`
Advances next-due by one interval on `done`, by UTC calendar math (daily to yearly or every N days)
A `done` repeated for the date of the latest completion writes nothing; MCP answers `already_recorded`
Lists obligations by next-due date with an overdue flag
`brain_pledge` stores one-off promises with a due date, a source page and quotes verified against that source
`brain_intake_pledges` checks a whole batch before writing and dedupes by sha256 of title, due and source
A counterparty becomes a `promised_to` edge only when the name resolves to exactly one canonical entity
`brain agenda` returns conflicts, focus blocks (default 60 min) and outside organisers from agent-given events
Opt-in hook `counterparty-brief` injects once per session dated shareable facts about the one person named
limits: Reads no calendar API: events come from the agent, and agenda writes nothing
Pledges have no CLI verb; they are written through the MCP tools
The counterparty brief stays inert until `counterparty_brief_enabled` is on and trigger words are declared

features.name: Intentions and current state
features.summary: Per-workstream current-intention documents with history, and an overwrite-only lane for the exact current state.
capabilities: `brain intention set` writes `Brain/intentions/<scope>.md`, bumps `version`, appends the old text to a history
Setting a chain to the text it already holds writes nothing; MCP answers `already_recorded`
Retires a chain into `Brain/intentions/history/` on `move`
`brain_intention` answers at the caller's reach: a withheld chain reads as absent and cannot be overwritten
`brain state set|get|list|clear` keeps one current value per aspect slug, overwritten with no history
The exact-state lane is kept out of the search index and retrieval, so a superseded value never resurfaces
On a machine switched to the brain store both lanes are kept as store records instead of `Brain/` files
limits: Exact state has no MCP tool; it is CLI-only
Neither lane is injected into the session context automatically; agents read it on request

features.name: Knowledge gaps
features.summary: Ranks recurring queries the vault answers poorly and can surface them as an agenda at session start.
capabilities: `brain_search` with `telemetry: true` logs redacted terms, result count and, with `evidence_pack`, coverage
`brain knowledge-gaps` ranks by count times (1 - coverage, else share of runs with results); min 2 by default
Filters by date range, minimum occurrences, maximum satisfaction (0 to 1) and limit; read-only
Keeps the demand log as a per-device JSONL shard under `Brain/log/`, compacted past 1 MB; no raw query stored
With `gap_loop_enabled`, the session-end hook promotes gaps seen 3+ times to notes in `Brain/gap-tasks/`
Closes a gap task once its topic recalls at 0.5 coverage or more
Injects open gap tasks as an agenda at session start (`gap-agenda`)
Logs context-pack recall-adequacy misses under `recall_gate_telemetry`, never summed with gap counts
limits: Off by default: the log needs per-call `telemetry` or `recall_gate_telemetry`, the hooks `gap_loop_enabled`
Gap topics are term buckets and telemetry codes, not generated questions
